params.body:
The trends list showed nine cards and a "Load more trends" button. With trends now on the site by rule, the list is longer, and a reader had to click for every nine.

## What changes

- `revealOnScroll` (`resources/js/app.js`): an Alpine component that shows the next nine cards when a marker under the grid comes within a screen of view. If the marker is still in view after the cards render, it keeps going.
- `resources/views/pages/trends.blade.php` uses it.
  - The button stays, for keyboards and for browsers without IntersectionObserver. It disappears once every card is shown.
  - The stale comment about a cap of 48 is updated.

Every card is still in the first response. Nothing is fetched while scrolling.

## Tests

- In a browser with 30 cards:
  - desktop: 9, then 18, 27, 30 while scrolling;
  - 390 px wide: 9, then 18, 27 and on.
- `php artisan test` on the 23 feature tests that render the trends pages: 148 of 148.
params.title: Trends list: more trends appear while scrolling
